newsitem.title: USA: Enron Corp. to acquire Enron Power and Pipelines.
newsitem.headline: Enron Corp. to acquire Enron Power and Pipelines.

text.p: Enron Corp. said Monday it agreed to buy the rest of its partly owned subsidiary, Enron Global Power & Pipelines L.L.C., which manages some of its overseas operations, in a deal that values the unit at about $910 million.
Enron Corp., which owns about 13.5 million of Enron Global's 26 million outstanding shares, said it agreed to pay $35 a share for the remaining stake.
Enron had first proposed the acquisition in May, when it bid $32 a share for the rest of Enron Global.
Enron Global's stock closed at $33.31, down 37.5 cents, and Enron Corp. closed at $35.81, up 19 cents, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
Enron said Enron Global's assets include two power plants in the Philippines, power plants in Guatemala and the Dominican Republic and natural gas pipeline systems in Argentina and Colombia.
Enron Global will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Enron Corp. after the acquisition, which is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter, Enron said.
